fun.why: Vayne, Yasuo, Ekko and Vi are easy, but 25 answers across every role (Corki R, Talon, Sona, Ivern's Daisy) means nobody gets them all.

champion:Vayne.why: Silver Bolts is the archetypal third-hit passive.

champion:Kennen.why: Mark of the Storm three-stack stun is known but not first.

champion:Jax.why: Grandmaster third-hit is known to Jax players.

champion:Gnar.why: Hyper W stacks are moderately known.

champion:Brand.why: Blaze detonation at 3 stacks is moderately known.

champion:Talon.why: Blade's End three Wounds; often forgotten.

champion:Corki.why: Every third Missile Barrage is the Big One, rarely thought of.

champion:Mordekaiser.why: Darkness Rise after three hits; few connect it.

champion:Nunu.why: Snowball Barrage three hits; very few think of it.

champion:Skarner.why: Reworked Q third attack; very few know.

champion:Yasuo.why: 'Q3' is one of the best-known third-cast effects in the game.

champion:Yone.why: Same Q3 pattern as Yasuo, slightly less top-of-mind.

champion:Seraphine.why: Every third spell echoes; known to her players.

champion:Sona.why: Power Chord after three spells; few remember the count.

gemCandidates.why: 'Oh of course!': every third Missile Barrage is the Big One, visible every game but rarely remembered. About 0.05.
Blade's End bleed after three hits is his core passive but players forget it; about 0.08.
Three Acquired Taste stacks to stun or devour is his signature, rarely framed as 'three-hit'; about 0.1, just outside the likeliest half.
